evals.prompt: I want to build a CRM for small real-estate teams. Agents manage leads, brokers see pipeline reports. What platforms should I build first?
evals.expected_output: Recommends Web-First. Asks about or assumes team size and SOC 2/enterprise needs. Includes an Assumptions -> Decisions table and a metric gate for Tier 2.

evals.prompt: Fitness tracking app for gym-goers in India, I'm a solo Kotlin developer. Design the architecture.
evals.expected_output: Recommends Android-First. Scales the timeline for a solo developer and says so. Uses target API 36+ and minSdk 24, not API 34 or minSdk 21.

evals.prompt: I want to build a Chrome extension that summarizes articles with an LLM. Which platforms and architecture?
evals.expected_output: Recommends Browser-Extension-First (not Web-First). Addresses AI inference placement and per-user inference cost against the revenue model. Mentions Manifest V3.

evals.prompt: Telehealth app where patients message their therapist and log mood daily. Should I go iOS first or web first?
evals.expected_output: Flags regulated health data and applies the Compliance Overlay: BAA required from every vendor touching PHI, audit logs, encryption. Adds compliance items to Tier 1 release gates. Says to confirm with counsel.

evals.prompt: Two of us want to ship a habit tracker on iPhone and Android at the same time within 3 months. We both know React. Native or cross-platform?
evals.expected_output: Recommends a cross-platform implementation (React Native/Expo) while keeping a platform-first template for sequencing, and explains why. Does not claim Flutter lacks HealthKit support.

evals.prompt: We make a BLE smart ring. Need a companion app that syncs sleep data to the cloud and a dashboard for users. Architecture?
evals.expected_output: Uses the hardware-companion path: mobile-first or iOS-first with background BLE, firmware-update flow, web dashboard later. Names the combination explicitly.

evals.prompt: Design the architecture for a marketplace where home cooks sell meals: buyers order on their phones, cooks manage menus and orders on a laptop. Run without asking me questions.
evals.expected_output: Runs the isolation fallback: no questions asked. Combines Mobile-First (buyers) + Web-First (cooks) on one backend. Flags payments (PCI: hosted payment pages). Every inferred answer appears in the Assumptions -> Decisions table.

evals.prompt: I'm building a multiplayer mobile game with Unity. What platforms should I launch on?
evals.expected_output: States that games are outside this skill's templates, gives only general platform-order guidance, and does not force-fit a template.
